envelope.reference_impl: tt-bio device fold (ttnn), NOT a CPU reference: --accelerator cpu was silently ignored for this ttnn-only model until b245eedd0 (issue #10), so these fp32/bf16 shared-draw refs were computed on the card (autocast off/on) and the envelope denominator collapsed to ~0. The leg is legacy_rdx now and scores against the harvested external reference (top-level provenance); this block is retained only as the fixture cache key and must not be read as a CPU-torch reference.

invalidation_rule: Regenerate this fixture ONLY when the pinned reference_commit/version changes or the settings above change. For any other change (device seeds, device code, release tag) the fixture is reused as-is and only the device side re-runs.
